text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "twice as many red ties"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 0.5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "50% more (as a fraction)"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 200, "unit": "$", "kind": "money", "span": "spent $200 on blue ties"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 40, "unit": "$", "kind": "money", "span": "cost $40 each"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q4", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "extra cost per red tie over a blue tie"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q4", "s1"], "out": "s2", "note": "price of a red tie"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q3", "q4"], "out": "s3", "note": "number of blue ties bought"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "number of red ties bought (twice the blue ties)"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s2", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "total spent on red ties"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q3", "s5"], "out": "s6", "note": "total spent on blue plus red ties"}], "target": {"kind": "money", "scope": "total amount John spent on ties"}, "dismissed": []}
